answer_1.quote: We develop the AcT2I benchmark to evaluate the ability of T2I models to generate images from textual prompts that describe actions.
answer_1.outputs: images from textual prompts describing actions

answer_2.quote: We explore CLIPScore ) and a DINOv2   (DinoScore) to automatically evaluate the generated images.

answer_3.quote: We also explored using the multimodal LLM llava-v1.6-vicuna-13b-hf as a VQA-style evaluator.

answer_4.quote: A total of 25 annotators, hired via Amazon Mechanical Turk where each image was independently rated by 3 annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Each annotator was instructed to answer "Yes" or "No" to the question: "Does the image accurately depict the action described in the prompt?".
